capabilities: Replace the vowel behind the cursor with first- to fourth-tone versions
Remove tone marks from a vowel
Type ü tones using the letter v
Show tone order in a status bar item
extras: Default shortcuts use Alt plus 1-4 and Alt+R; the README mentions a demo section whose content is not shown.
problem: Writing pinyin tone marks in Obsidian normally requires installing an extra keyboard layout or IME.
summary: Typing helper that replaces the vowel under the cursor with its toned pinyin equivalent via five commands and hotkeys.
